children.text: Limit: the most CPU this server can use.

children.name: h
children.text: Limit: the most memory this server can use.

children.name: h
children.text: Off: the server reserves its full CPU and memory (Guaranteed QoS). On: it reserves less, so more servers fit on a node, and uses more up to its limit when the node has room (Burstable QoS).

children.name: h
children.text: Counted when the server is placed on a node. 0 reserves nothing.

children.name: h
children.text: When a node runs out of memory, servers above their reservation are stopped first. Keep it close to real use.

children.text: Resizing requires a StorageClass with allowVolumeExpansion: true.

children.text: Leave blank to use the cluster default.
